It is averred in the application that the delay in filing the revision petition is neither deliberate nor intentional but due to the facts stated above.
3. The applicants have sufficiently explained the delay in filing the present revision petition, which is not willful but due to the aforesaid unavoidable circumstances.

sentences.text: 6(ii) In support of their claim of compensation in terms of the award dated 30.07.2010, passed in Reference Petition No. 65 of 2004, petitioners pleaded that their father late .

Sh. Bhup Singh s/o Sh. Dhani Ram was co-sharer with Sh.
Surinder Kumar in the land and structure comprised in Khewat No. 70, Khatauni No. 86, Khasra No. 268/191 measuring 00-02-00 bighas, situated in Mohal Kyan/240, Tehsil Sundernagar District Mandi.

6(iii) The aforesaid land alongwith structure comprised in Khasra 268/191 was acquired by the respondents for construction of Kol Dam, under notification dated 11.12.2000, issued under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act (the Act in short).
Award No. 02/2002 was passed on 23.07.2002.
The compensation was paid in terms of the award to Sh. Surinder Kumar.

In reference Petition No. 65/2004, preferred by Sh. Surinder Kumar under Section 18 of the Act,
award was passed on 30.07.2010, enhancing the compensation.
The appeal against the award dated 30.07.2010, filed by the respondents was dismissed by this Court.

6(iv) Petitioners pleaded that they were also entitled to the benefit of the award dated 30.07.2010,
passed in Reference Petition No. 65/2004, which was filed by the co-sharer of the suit land i.e. Sh.
Surinder Kumar.

sentences.text: The respondents opposed the application.
Their defence was that Khasra No. 268/191 was never acquired by the State.
Award No. 2 of 2002 was passed by the Land Acquisition Collector concerning Khasra No. 191/1.
It was also pleaded that Sh. Surinder Kumar had not filed any reference petition on behalf of the other co-sharers.
The petitioners had also not preferred any reference petition either under Section 18 or 28 of the Act.
Neither the petitioners nor their predecessors were party in Reference Petition No. 65 of 2004.
Therefore, prayer was made for dismissal of the application.

7. Learned District Judge after examining the record came to the conclusion that: -
 Land comprised in Khewat No. 70, Khatauni No.86, Khasra No. 268/191 measuring 00-02-00 bighas regarding which present application was moved, had not been acquired.
In the reference sought by Sh. Surinder Kumar under Section 18 of the Act, khewat number of the land was 48 and not 70.

In the list of unauthorized built up structures, .
Sh.Surinder Kumar was shown to have built two rooms over Khasra No. 191 and not over Khasra No. 268/191.
In notifications dated 11.01.2000 and 27.04.2021, the land bearing Khasra No. 268/191 had not been mentioned.
Even in the details of compensation paid, only Khewat No. 40 has been mentioned and not Khewat No.70.
None of the documents attached to the main case file reflected acquisition of Khewat No.70, Khasra No. 268/191.

In view of above, learned District Judge held that the premise of the application that the land comprised in Khewat No.70, Khatauni No. 86 Khasra No. 268/191 measuring 00-02-00 bighas was acquired by the respondents was factually incorrect.

The land qua which the petitioners had filed the application was not the subject matter of the reference, therefore, question as to whether the co-sharers had made reference on their own behalf or also for other sharers as well, does not arise for consideration.
The application, therefore, was dismissed.

As per the impugned order, for deciding the .
application made by the petitioners, record of main file had also been requisitioned by the learned Court.
Finding were returned on that basis.

Neither any submission has been made before me nor any document has been placed on record to contest the factual observations and findings recorded by the learned District Judge in the impugned order.
The self-explanatory facts as observed by the learned District Judge in the impugned order for dismissing the application do not call for any interference.
Accordingly, the present petition is dismissed.
